# Tools, resources and prompts

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools.ts from the running server; do not edit by hand. -->

The server registers 33 tools, 7 resources and 5 prompts. Every read tool answers from the mirror when the stored copy is fresh enough for its kind and asks Strava otherwise; its result ends with a line saying which (see [How sync works](../sync.md#freshness-and-provenance)).

## The mirror

### `strava_query`

**Query the Strava Mirror (SQL)**

Run a read-only DuckDB SQL query against the local mirror of all the athlete's Strava data. Use strava_schema first to see the tables. Main tables: activity, activity_stream_point (per-point streams: time, distance, lat, lng, altitude, heartrate, cadence, watts, temp, velocity_smooth, grade_smooth), activity_lap, activity_split, activity_best_effort, activity_segment_effort, segment, activity_zone_bucket, gear, route, athlete_stats. Units: meters, seconds, m/s. raw_current holds every payload as JSON (column body) for fields not in a typed table. Costs no Strava API calls.

*read-only, idempotent.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sql` | string | yes | One DuckDB SELECT statement (DESCRIBE, SUMMARIZE and EXPLAIN also work). |
| `max_rows` | integer (min 1, max 5000) | no | Maximum rows to return (default 200). Default `200`. |

### `strava_schema`

**Describe the Strava Mirror**

List the mirror's tables and views with their descriptions and row counts, or, given a table name, its columns with types, units and descriptions. Use before strava_query.

*read-only, idempotent.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table` | string | no | A table or view name; omit to list them all. |

### `strava_sync_status`

**Strava Mirror Sync Status**

How complete and fresh the local mirror is: activity coverage (details, streams, zones), the sync queue by kind, last run of each periodic task, recent errors, rate-limit usage, and any fields Strava returns that the schema does not yet map.

*read-only, idempotent.*

No parameters.

## Streams

### `strava_get_activity_streams`

**Get Activity Streams**

Get high-resolution time-series data for an activity (heart rate, power, cadence, altitude, GPS coordinates, etc.). Data is downsampled if too large.

*read-only, idempotent.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `activity_id` | integer | yes | The activity ID |
| `keys` | array of `time`, `distance`, `latlng`, `altitude`, `velocity_smooth`, `heartrate`, `cadence`, `watts`, `temp`, `moving`, `grade_smooth` | yes | Stream types to retrieve: time, distance, latlng, altitude, velocity_smooth, heartrate, cadence, watts, temp, moving, grade_smooth |
| `max_points` | integer (min 10, max 2000) | no | Maximum data points to return (10-2000, default 500). Streams are downsampled if larger. Default `500`. |

### `strava_get_segment_effort_streams`

**Get Segment Effort Streams**

Get high-resolution time-series data for a segment effort.

*read-only, idempotent.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `effort_id` | string | yes | The segment effort ID |
| `keys` | array of `time`, `distance`, `latlng`, `altitude`, `velocity_smooth`, `heartrate`, `cadence`, `watts`, `temp`, `moving`, `grade_smooth` | yes | Stream types to retrieve |
| `max_points` | integer (min 10, max 2000) | no | Maximum data points (10-2000, default 500) Default `500`. |

### `strava_get_segment_streams`

**Get Segment Streams**

Get GPS coordinates, distance, and altitude data for a segment.

*read-only, idempotent.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `segment_id` | integer | yes | The segment ID |
| `keys` | array of `latlng`, `distance`, `altitude` | yes | Stream types: latlng, distance, altitude |
| `max_points` | integer (min 10, max 2000) | no | Maximum data points (10-2000, default 500) Default `500`. |

### `strava_get_route_streams`

**Get Route Streams**

Get GPS coordinates, distance, and altitude data for a route.

*read-only, idempotent.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `route_id` | string | yes | The route ID |
| `max_points` | integer (min 10, max 2000) | no | Maximum data points (10-2000, default 500) Default `500`. |

## Uploads

### `strava_get_upload`

**Get Upload Status**

Check the processing status of an upload. Returns status, error info, and the resulting activity ID once complete.

*read-only, idempotent.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `upload_id` | integer | yes | The upload ID |

### `strava_create_upload`

**Upload Activity File**

Upload an activity file (FIT, TCX, or GPX format) to create a new activity. The file content must be base64-encoded. Returns an upload ID to check processing status with strava_get_upload.

*writes to Strava.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file_content` | string | yes | Base64-encoded file content |
| `data_type` | `fit`, `fit.gz`, `tcx`, `tcx.gz`, `gpx`, `gpx.gz` | yes | File format: fit, fit.gz, tcx, tcx.gz, gpx, gpx.gz |
| `name` | string | no | Activity name |
| `description` | string | no | Activity description |
| `trainer` | boolean | no | Whether this is a trainer/indoor activity |
| `commute` | boolean | no | Whether this is a commute |
| `external_id` | string | no | External identifier for deduplication |

Star or unstar a segment for the authenticated athlete.

### `strava_export_segment_gpx`

**Export Segment as GPX**

Export a Strava segment as a GPX file for navigation. Returns GPX XML that can be imported into Garmin Connect, Coros, or other GPS devices. Note: The Strava API does not support uploading routes, so the GPX must be imported manually into your device/app.

*read-only, idempotent.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `segment_id` | integer | yes | The segment ID |

## Activities

### `strava_list_activities`

**List Athlete Activities**

List the authenticated athlete's activities, newest first. Supports filtering by date range and pagination. Served from the local mirror (refreshed from Strava at most every 15 minutes).

*read-only, idempotent.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `before` | integer | no | Only activities before this epoch timestamp (seconds) |
| `after` | integer | no | Only activities after this epoch timestamp (seconds) |
| `page` | integer (min 1) | no | Page number (default 1) Default `1`. |
| `per_page` | integer (min 1, max 200) | no | Results per page (1-200, default 30) Default `30`. |

### `strava_get_activity`

**Get Activity**

Get detailed information about a specific activity including description, calories, splits, laps, segment efforts, best efforts, and gear. Served from the local mirror; recent activities are refreshed from Strava.

*read-only, idempotent.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `activity_id` | integer | yes | The activity ID |
| `include_all_efforts` | boolean | no | Kept for compatibility: the mirror stores every segment effort and always returns them all. Default `false`. |

### `strava_create_activity`

**Create Activity**

Create a manual activity entry. Requires activity:write scope.

*writes to Strava.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | The name of the activity |
| `sport_type` | one of 50 values (`AlpineSki`, `BackcountrySki`, `Badminton`, `Canoeing`, `Crossfit`, `EBikeRide`, ...) | yes | The sport type (e.g. Run, Ride, Swim, Hike) |
| `start_date_local` | string | yes | ISO 8601 date/time for activity start in local timezone (e.g. 2024-01-15T08:30:00Z) |
| `elapsed_time` | integer (min 1) | yes | Total elapsed time in seconds |
| `description` | string | no | Activity description |
| `distance` | number (min 0) | no | Distance in meters |
| `trainer` | boolean | no | Whether this was a trainer/indoor activity |
| `commute` | boolean | no | Whether this was a commute |

### `strava_update_activity`

**Update Activity**

Update an activity's mutable properties. Requires activity:write scope. Only provided fields are updated.

*writes to Strava, idempotent.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `activity_id` | integer | yes | The activity ID to update |
| `name` | string | no | New name |
| `sport_type` | one of 50 values (`AlpineSki`, `BackcountrySki`, `Badminton`, `Canoeing`, `Crossfit`, `EBikeRide`, ...) | no | New sport type |
| `description` | string | no | New description |
| `gear_id` | string | no | Gear ID to associate (e.g. "b12345"), or "none" to remove |
| `trainer` | boolean | no | Whether this is a trainer activity |
| `commute` | boolean | no | Whether this is a commute |
| `hide_from_home` | boolean | no | Whether to mute this activity in the feed |

## Athlete

### `strava_get_authenticated_athlete`

**Get Authenticated Athlete**

Get the profile of the currently authenticated athlete, including name, location, stats summary, bikes, and shoes.

*read-only, idempotent.*

No parameters.

### `strava_get_athlete_zones`

**Get Athlete Zones**

Get the authenticated athlete's heart rate and power zones.

*read-only, idempotent.*

No parameters.

### `strava_get_athlete_stats`

**Get Athlete Stats**

Get activity statistics for an athlete: recent, year-to-date, and all-time totals for runs, rides, and swims. Includes biggest ride distance and biggest climb.

*read-only, idempotent.*

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `athlete_id` | integer | yes | The athlete ID. Use the authenticated athlete's ID from strava_get_authenticated_athlete. |

## Resources

Read-only context a client can pull into a conversation.

| URI | Description |
|---|---|
| `strava://athlete/profile` | Current authenticated athlete profile including name, location, bikes, and shoes. |
| `strava://athlete/stats` | Year-to-date and all-time activity totals for runs, rides, and swims. |
| `strava://reference/sport-types` | Valid Strava sport_type values for create/update activity and for interpreting activity data. |
| `strava://reference/stream-types` | Available stream types for the stream tools. Pass one or more keys as the keys parameter. |
| `strava://activity/{activityId}` | Detailed Strava activity by ID. |
| `strava://segment/{segmentId}` | Detailed Strava segment by ID. |
| `strava://route/{routeId}/gpx` | Export a Strava route as GPX. |

## Prompts

Prompt templates that gather data from the mirror and ask the model for an analysis.

| Prompt | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `weekly-summary` | `week_start`? | Summarize training for a given week based on Strava activities. |
| `activity-analysis` | `activity_id` | Fetch a Strava activity with streams and request a detailed analysis of pacing, effort, and performance. |
| `training-plan-review` | `days`? | Review recent training load and suggest adjustments based on activity history. |
| `segment-comparison` | `segment_id` | Compare all your efforts on a Strava segment over time to identify trends and improvements. |
| `race-readiness` | `distance`? | Assess fitness and race readiness based on recent training history and athlete stats. |
